sentences.en: Outside the fancily decorated sales office, a few trucks rumble in and out of a vast, dusty construction site in the outskirts of Hangzhou, nicknamed heaven on earth for its picturesque West Lake.

sentences.en: In William Frederick Yeames's classic Victorian painting And When Did You Last See Your Father? a fancily dressed royalist boy faces a grim tribunal of Cromwellian zealots.
sentences.vi: Trong bức tranh cổ điển thời Victoria của William Frederick Yeames Và lần cuối bạn gặp lại cha mình là khi nào? một cậu bé theo chủ nghĩa bảo hoàng ăn mặc lộng lẫy phải đối mặt với tòa án nghiệt ngã gồm những người nhiệt thành ở Cromwellian.

sentences.en: Since Buddhism was introduced into China in two—Han dynasty, there has appeared a new face in the big fancily of Chinese thought and culture.

sentences.en: I had not seen my nephew for a long time. By then, he was chewing a fancily wrapped bubble gum.
